tool_args.rationale: The five observations vary only u_now; all other inputs and H are fixed, leaving genuine ambiguity between a saturating recruitment law and the signaled two-hop mobility bridge. Acquire the open-branch probe to distinguish them at lower cost than an extra trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fixed-condition input sweep is compatible with a saturating response, but does not distinguish it from the bridge mechanism.
The observed curvature is inconsistent with a simple bilinear response over this input range.
A second branch condition is more directly discriminating than denser sampling of the existing fixed-condition sweep.
